name: baoyu-canvas
description: Writes design canvases, artboards side by side, as files in your workspace and opens them in a canvas editor that runs on your computer. Compare options, retype copy, adjust tweaks and comment for the agent. Runs locally on Node.js 20 or later; nothing leaves your computer unless you share it.
